description: List free booking start times on one date for a business that takes bookings (get_business returns can: 'book'). Use before create_request with kind 'book', and offer the customer only these times. Times are the business's local time. Send service_id so only times where the whole service fits are returned (a 90-minute service needs 90 free minutes); for restaurants that book tables, send party_size. Bookings open up to 14 days ahead. If a date has no times, the reply lists open_days to try instead. Read-only, no side effects. No sign-in or API key needed. Rate limit: 600 read calls and 60 create_request calls per hour per client IP; over the limit you get error -32000 'Too many requests' (wait, then retry).

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD, in the business's local time; today up to 14 days ahead.

party_size.description: Optional, for table bookings: the number of people (up to booking.max_party from get_business). Default 2.

service_id.description: Optional. The id of a service (offer of kind 'service') from get_business; its length decides which times fit.

slug.description: The business's id from search_businesses (the 'slug' field).

staff_id.description: Optional. A person from get_business 'staff' when the customer wants someone specific.

name: get_available_times
title: Get free booking times
